Analogy: If standard physics treats the universe like a stage where particles move around, SAT treats the universe like a woven fabric. The Lagrangian is the set of rules for how the threads are woven; the Energy-Tension Axiom explains that "mass" is just the tension created when a thread is pulled sideways against the weave; and the Click Rate is the rhythmic sound of those tight threads vibrating as the "now" of time sweeps over them.
